title: Monster Pile-Up #1 Image 2008 Astounding Wolf-Man Firebreather Proof Kirkman
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Monster Pile-Up #1 (Image Comics, July 2008), one-shot anthology with all-new stories of The Astounding Wolf-Man, Firebreather, The Perhapanauts and Proof by their regular creative teams. Writers Robert Kirkman, Phil Hester, Todd Dezago and Alex Grecian; art by Jason Howard, Andy Kuhn, Craig Rousseau and Riley Rossmo. $1.99 cover price.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
